Native fortress status and position labels, Linux ELF
Reference executable: dwarfort
Build ID: bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c
Reconstruction from decoded instructions and installed vanilla ENTITY RAWs.
All coordinates below are native ELF virtual addresses.

FIXED FORTRESS RANK: 12cc4c0..12cc5c4
  if plotinfo.king_arrived (byte 297bf0a):
      return (byte 297e298 & 0x20) ? "Mountainhome" : "Capital"
  switch plotinfo.fortress_rank (word 297bf02):
      1 -> "Hamlet"; 2 -> "Village"; 3 -> "Town";
      4 -> "City"; 5 -> "Metropolis"; default -> "Outpost"
  HUD calls this formatter at 1681245. Strings longer than 18 bytes are
  shortened to 18 bytes with dots at offsets 15..17. Draw returns at 168128e.
  This producer does not read LAND_NAME. "Fortress" is a retained translation
  reader compatibility label, not a branch of this native switch.

NOBLES POSITION COLUMN: owner 16e23a0..16e8a57
  compact mode:
      position = entries[display_indices[row]].position (+18)
      text = position.land_name (+258) if its length (+260) != 0
             else position.name[0] (+98)
      capitalize_string_first_word(text)
      if length > 22: shorten to 22; overwrite offsets 19..21 with dots
      addst(text) at 16e2be2; return 16e2be7
  full mode:
      position = entries[row].position (+18)
      text = position.land_name (+258) if nonempty else position.name[0] (+98)
      capitalize_string_first_word(text)
      addst(text) at 16e379a; return 16e379f
  Empty LAND_NAME branches are 16e4259 and 16e4478. Both rejoin the same
  capitalization/draw path. The complete switch and both fallbacks are in
  native-producers.asm. The label does not select the holder's gender; the
  separate holder formatter owns NAME_MALE/NAME_FEMALE and spouse titles.

RAW FIELD FAMILY
  Scanned installed data/vanilla/*/objects/entity*.txt token streams.
  LAND_NAME occurs on ENTITY:MOUNTAIN positions BARON, COUNT and DUKE:
      LAND_HOLDER 1 / "a barony" -> title-column "男爵"
      LAND_HOLDER 2 / "a county" -> title-column "伯爵"
      LAND_HOLDER 3 / "a duchy"  -> title-column "公爵"
  raw-position-sources.tsv retains all MOUNTAIN NAME and SPOUSE tokens, both
  singular and plural, plus every installed vanilla LAND_NAME. Gendered
  offices and consorts use the existing positions namespace. Land prose
  keeps its own meaning; these mappings apply only to actual title fields.

SHARED TRANSLATION CONSUMERS
  fortress/status.toml: fixed rank and land-title subgrammars.
  Nobles table: actual position column before ordinary dictionary lookup.
  Elevate whom? dialog: actual left-list button, same land-title grammar,
      otherwise existing positions grammar.
  Native ELF callers: both column modes and HUD rank, even if surrounding
      tabs/frame are occluded. Unknown position RAW captions retain native
      text as one field, preventing partial generic-name/word translation.
  HUD site-name/header layout: same full status grammar for recognition.
  General literal generation excludes fortress/status.toml; authored unit
      or squad names cannot acquire these meanings by matching their spelling.
